_leggimi: Elenco delle versioni provate per il pack DLSS 5 Neural su Radeon (Football Life 2026 / PES 2021), by oLd_pZ, dalla v1.6 del pack in poi. L'installer legge questo file dal gist ufficiale a ogni avvio e usa queste versioni. Il runtime lo ricava dal setup ufficiale di Blanco (setup_url): estrae la DLL, controlla originale_sha256, applica le modifiche in patch e controlla pass1_sha256. Istruzioni complete in COME AGGIORNARE - HOW TO UPDATE.txt
_readme: List of tested versions for the DLSS 5 Neural on Radeon pack (Football Life 2026 / PES 2021), by oLd_pZ, from pack v1.6 on. The installer reads this file from the official gist at every run and installs these versions. The runtime is built from Blanco's official setup (setup_url): the DLL is extracted, checked against originale_sha256, given the changes in patch and checked against pass1_sha256.
